photorealAdapterClassification.comparison: exact ordinal adapterId match on an exact single operation=photoreal and exact single adapterId member
photorealAdapterClassification.unknownOrFutureAdapter: preserve and present the row as photoreal reader-only without coercing it to a known adapter
readerOnlyMutations: bulk cancel, retry, dismiss, reorder, or settings update
photorealAdapterClassification.bulkRule: a loaded reader-only photoreal row is never included in an id-targeted mutation; when authoritative terminal target planning is advertised, request the broader plan and mutate only returned safe ids while leaving protected ids unchanged; without that capability, a loaded matching reader-only row keeps bulk mutation fail-closed

queueOrder.defaultForNewJobs: append after every currently queued job
queueOrder.persistence: stored transactionally in the active Enhancement Jobs store; enhance/jobs.sqlite3 is current and enhance/jobs.json is legacy

pauseControl.location: enhancement_store_metadata.queue_paused in enhance/jobs.sqlite3, or top-level queuePaused in legacy enhance/jobs.json
pauseControl.route: POST /api/enhance/queue with an explicit paused boolean
pauseControl.pause: persist true under the same shared lock used to claim jobs; do not cancel or alter the running job
pauseControl.claimWhilePaused: return no job and leave every queued row unchanged
pauseControl.enqueueWhilePaused: append normally and preserve FIFO order without starting the new job
pauseControl.resume: persist false before waking the queue worker
pauseControl.restart: preserve the persisted pause state across process and application restarts

queuedPhotorealPromptUpdate.appliesTo: queued photoreal jobs using comfyui-flux2-photoreal only
queuedPhotorealPromptUpdate.afterClaim: return conflict without changing the running job

body.seed: integer from 0 to 2147483647, or null to request a new server-owned random seed

queuedPhotorealSettingsUpdateV1.appliesTo: queued photoreal jobs using comfyui-flux2-photoreal only
queuedPhotorealSettingsUpdateV1.updates: preset.denoise and the exact current prompt, negativePrompt, LoRA, steps, CFG, work resolution, and seed options; then presetHash and updatedAt
queuedPhotorealSettingsUpdateV1.perSourcePrompt: the WPF resolves enabled PNG metadata prompt mappings separately for each source before sending the body
queuedPhotorealSettingsUpdateV1.afterClaim: return conflict without changing the running job
queuedPhotorealSettingsUpdateV1.legacyReader: a WPF reader must require capabilities.queuedPhotorealSettingsUpdateV1 before sending the extended body

deferredBackendSkipV1.appliesTo: a queued executable job whose recognized adapter backend is temporarily unavailable
deferredBackendSkipV1.blockedRow: remain queued at the exact durable queueOrder with no presentation reorder, payload update, retry, cancellation, timestamp update, or other mutation
deferredBackendSkipV1.executionSelection: skip unavailable-backend rows only while selecting execution work and claim the earliest later runnable row in reader ordering
deferredBackendSkipV1.allBlocked: when every active queued row is waiting for an unavailable backend, stop the pump intentionally without reporting queued-without-pump
deferredBackendSkipV1.readyTransition: when the backend becomes ready, claim the row from its original queue position on the next explicit pump, recover, resume, enqueue action, or Companion restart
deferredBackendSkipV1.passiveReads: health and Jobs reads may report bounded readiness and waiting counts but never enqueue, wake, claim, retry, reorder, mutate, start a worker, or monitor external assets
deferredBackendSkipV1.pause: a paused queue claims nothing even when a deferred backend becomes ready; resume preserves the original ordering

fairGpuFamilyDispatchV1.scope: the single shared GPU lane only; the dormant CPU Video Trim lane is excluded
fairGpuFamilyDispatchV1.selection: when both families have runnable work, claim the earliest runnable job from the family opposite the most recently started exact GPU job; otherwise claim the earliest runnable job in reader ordering
fairGpuFamilyDispatchV1.familyFifo: within the selected family, preserve reader ordering and never rewrite queueOrder
fairGpuFamilyDispatchV1.durableCursor: derive the previous family from the latest valid startedAt across exact GPU jobs, using id as a stable equal-timestamp tie-breaker; do not add or passively write scheduler state
fairGpuFamilyDispatchV1.unavailableBackend: apply deferred-backend skip before family selection so an unavailable Krea row stays byte-equivalent while a later runnable image remains eligible
fairGpuFamilyDispatchV1.strictBarrier: never select across an unavailable adapter that is explicitly classified as a strict FIFO barrier
fairGpuFamilyDispatchV1.starvationBound: while both families remain runnable, no family starts two consecutive GPU jobs
fairGpuFamilyDispatchV1.restartAndRecovery: the derived cursor survives restart and recovery without requeue, reorder, retry, or timestamp mutation
fairGpuFamilyDispatchV1.singleGpu: claim and adapter execution remain inside the existing one physical cross-process GPU lease; fairness never creates a second worker

atomicImageEnqueueNext.videoRequest: reject with HTTP 400 and leave the queue unchanged
atomicImageEnqueueNext.next: insert first among queued jobs under the same shared lock used to claim jobs
atomicImageEnqueueNext.runningJob: leave unchanged and never preempt it
atomicImageEnqueueNext.normalization: persist contiguous queueOrder values from zero after insertion
atomicImageEnqueueNext.whilePaused: allow insertion but do not claim it until the queue resumes

request.ids: the complete current queued-job id order; 1 to 10000 unique strings, each 1 to 255 characters
request.orderRequestId: a canonical bounded idempotency key from 1 to 255 characters

queuedJobsBatchReorderV1.snapshotRule: under the same write lock used by claim, enqueue, and cancellation, require ids to be an exact set match for every currently queued job that has not been cancel-requested before writing
queuedJobsBatchReorderV1.snapshotConflict: return HTTP 409 with code QUEUED_ORDER_SNAPSHOT_CHANGED, orderRequestId, requestedCount, and currentCount; write nothing
queuedJobsBatchReorderV1.readerOnlyConflict: if any requested queued row has a malformed, unknown, or future operation, return HTTP 409 with code READER_ONLY_ENHANCEMENT_OPERATION and write nothing
queuedJobsBatchReorderV1.write: persist the requested contiguous queueOrder values and the matching idempotency receipt in one store write
preserves: job payloads and unknown additive fields

idempotency.sameRequestIdAndBody: return the durable original compact result with replayed true and do not write again
idempotency.sameRequestIdChangedBody: return HTTP 409 with code QUEUED_ORDER_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT and write nothing
idempotency.receiptStorage: preserve compatible unknown receipt fields; retain a rolling maximum of 128 receipts and 256 KiB, evicting oldest receipts first
idempotency.queueOrderRevision: a persisted non-negative monotonic safe integer dedicated to successful queued-order commits

queuedJobsBatchReorderV1.wpf: when every queued row is reorder-safe, apply each valid move to the in-memory presentation immediately, coalesce a short burst to its latest complete order, use a fresh orderRequestId per transmitted order, and fall back to the protected per-job route when the capability, row safety, or request bounds are unavailable

readerOrdering: running job first without changing it
queued jobs with a valid queueOrder by ascending queueOrder
equal valid queueOrder values by createdAt then a stable reader tie-breaker
queued jobs with missing, null, negative, fractional, or non-numeric queueOrder by createdAt then a stable reader tie-breaker
terminal jobs by the existing workspace inventory order

mutations.up: swap the selected queued job with the queued job immediately before it
mutations.down: swap the selected queued job with the queued job immediately after it
mutations.next: place the selected queued job first among queued jobs
mutations.bulkCancel: cancel queued jobs only; do not alter the running job
mutations.normalization: after a queue mutation, persist contiguous queueOrder values starting at zero

workerRules.claim: apply fairGpuFamilyDispatchV1 when advertised, otherwise claim the first queued job in reader ordering
